title: Settings
intro: Your own preferences, and the defaults a stall starts from until it sets its own.
platformNote: Saved with your account for now. Whether a changed default reaches stalls that never set their own is still to be decided.
timezoneNote: Every date and time on the platform is read in this zone.

website.title: Website status
website.intro: Turn the whole site off temporarily while you fix something, then switch it back on when you're done.
website.loadErrorTitle: Could not load the website status
website.loadErrorText: Check your connection and try again.
website.maintenanceText: Only admins can sign in right now. Everyone else sees a maintenance notice.
website.confirmText: Every visitor except admins is redirected to a maintenance notice right away. You can turn it off again whenever you're ready.
website.toastOn: Maintenance mode is on. Everyone but admins is locked out.
website.toastOff: Maintenance mode is off. MarketLink is open again.
website.error: Could not update the website status. Please try again.
